description: Core of GraphQL-Markdown: generates Markdown documentation from a GraphQL schema.
Anonymous, opt-out usage telemetry for the GraphQL-Markdown CLI.
Default Markdown/MDX printer for GraphQL-Markdown, rendering GraphQL schema types for any supported framework.
Detects GraphQL schema changes so GraphQL-Markdown only regenerates documentation that changed.
Helpers for customizing GraphQL-Markdown output, such as directives and custom rendering.
GraphQL schema loading, introspection and type utilities for GraphQL-Markdown.
Formatter presets for GraphQL-Markdown: Docusaurus, Starlight, Fumadocs, Vocs, HonKit, Hugo, MkDocs, DocFX, mdBook and generic MDX.
Logger used by the GraphQL-Markdown packages.
